blocks.text: Lima, Peru—Pope Leo XIV ended a 12-day homecoming tour of South America on Monday that eased doubts about his recovery from cancer surgery and highlighted the social justice priorities shaping his papacy. The 71-year-old pontiff traveled through Uruguay, Argentina and Peru — a demanding itinerary many doubted he could complete a month after lung surgery. From the high Andes to the sweltering Amazon, US-born Leo crisscrossed a continent where he spent nearly two decades as a missionary, picking up Peruvian citizenship along the way.
